div.div: Illustration of the compositional approach to adding multimodal capabilities to Llama 3 that we study in this paper. This approach leads to a multimodal model that is trained in five stages: (1) language model pre-training, (2) multi-modal encoder pre-training, (3) vision adapter training, (4) model finetuning, and (5) speech adapter training.
